issues: Meaning drift/incorrect reference in item 18: translation says amendment is Government Regulation No. 58 of 2010 amending Government Regulation No. 90 of 2010, but the original states Government Regulation No. 58 of 2010 amending Government Regulation No. 27 of 1983.

Minor meaning drift in item 18 citation details: original citation refers to State Gazette Year 2007 No. 112 etc. as given; translation should keep the same but must not imply the wrong amended regulation number.

Meaning drift in item 11: "gugurnya pingsan" was mistranslated as "miscarriage and/or fainting"; it should refer to "miscarriage, fainting" (two separate outcomes) and the phrase structure was garbled.

Meaning drift in item 18: Indonesian term "Pengiriman" (sending/dispatch) was translated as "Transfer"; should be "Sending/Dispatch" to match the defined term and avoid confusion with other concepts (e.g., transfer/relocation already used in item 7).

Scrambled/incorrect list punctuation: item markers should be consistently formatted; items d and e end with periods while a–c end with semicolons, and d should end with a semicolon (not a period) to match the original structure.
Meaning drift: "pendamping" is translated as "companions"; in this legal context it should be "assistants"/"companions" is inaccurate. Use "companions" could mislead downstream interpretation.
Meaning drift: "Mahkamah Internasional" translated as "International Court"; should be "International Court of Justice" (International Court).
Meaning drift: 'pada masyarakat' should be 'for the public/community' (not 'to the community') in item (e).
Untranslated heading marker: "BAB V" should be translated to "CHAPTER V" to avoid leftover source-language text in the English legal text.
Scrambled numbering: paragraph (2) is merged into item b and missing its own marker/line break.
Meaning drift/grammar: '(2)' clause should be a separate paragraph; minor adjustment to reflect 'various forms of protection ... intended to prevent the emergence of' offenses/victims.
Meaning drift/terminology: "medicological" should be rendered as "medicolegal" (for legal evidentiary purposes).
Scrambled numbering/structure: paragraph (2) is merged into item k in the source; needs clear separation so item k ends before paragraph (2).

Meaning drift/omission: paragraph (1) omits that the protection concerns women and children who are victims of violence AND trafficking in persons (perempuan anak korban kekerasan dan perdagangan orang), not only children victims of both.
Meaning drift/wording: paragraph (4) is missing the object of implementation (“In carrying out [the facilitation] as referred to in paragraph (3) …”).

Meaning drift: 'perdagangan orang' translated as 'human trafficking' in item (d), but the original refers to protection of women and children and trafficking in persons; item (d) should cover protection of women and children and trafficking in persons (not 'protection ... as well as human trafficking').

Meaning drift/omission: paragraph (2) omits that the next year's policies/programs/activities are for the protection of women AND children victims of violence and trafficking in persons; it only says 'protection of women'.

Meaning drift/awkward rendering: "shall be threatened with criminal punishment" is an unnatural/mistranslated legal phrasing for "diancam dengan hukuman pidana"; should be rendered as "shall be subject to"/"shall be punished".

Meaning drift: list structure implies "neglect" as a type of violence; original includes "penelantaran" (neglect/abandonment) as a category of offense—translation should keep it as "neglect" but align list as "physical, psychological, sexual violence, neglect..." to match Indonesian phrasing.
Meaning drift: Indonesian civil-service rank "Pembina Utama Madya" is mistranslated as "Principal Senior Supervisor"; it should be rendered as the official rank title (e.g., "Senior Main Advisor").
Meaning drift/unnatural rendering: "Perpetrators ... are general in nature" should convey that perpetrators come from all walks of life (not limited by education/occupation/income).
Meaning drift: "give sanctions" should be "impose sanctions" in the legal sense.
Scrambled structure: Paragraph (1) and Paragraph (2) run together; needs separation to reflect original layout.
Meaning drift: "P2TP2A Kabupaten Banyuwangi" should be translated as "P2TP2A of Banyuwangi Regency" (missing "of"/relationship).
